Eggs are one of the most versatile ingredients in the kitchen — and this World Egg Day, we’re taking them beyond the usual breakfast!
In this video, discover 4 delicious egg recipes, each with a completely different flavour and style. From a crispy, flaky Egg Puff filled with spicy onion-tomato masala, to flavour-packed Egg Tikka with an Indian-style marinade, there’s something for every egg lover.
We’re also making Turkish Eggs with creamy garlic yoghurt, soft poached eggs and chilli butter, followed by Scrambled Eggs with Mince, combining fluffy eggs with flavourful spiced chicken mince.
